scripts.test:backend: cd backend && uv run --python 3.11 --with-requirements requirements.txt --with-requirements requirements-dev.txt -- python -m pytest tests/ -q --tb=short --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=xml:coverage.xml
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.quality: npm test && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.vercel-build: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend run build
